about: Dell services the owner decided about, and the state each should be in (startup-audit/decisions.json, 2026-11-09). Wiregent reports drift; it never fixes it on its own.

rules.why: Your rule: Automatic (Delayed Start). It starts the AWCC helpers (boost key, modes); Delayed keeps it out of the boot path.
rules.critical_why: With DellTechHub on Manual or Disabled, the AWCC boost key and modes stop working after the next restart (seen 2026-10-14).

rules.why: You chose to keep SupportAssist on Automatic (Delayed) for now (2026-11-09).
Kept: Alienware Update's backend and the AWCC bridge.
